value_kinds.name: String
value_kinds.description: A quoted string, for example "my title".

value_kinds.name: Date
value_kinds.description: An ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD), or a date function such as today().

value_kinds.name: Boolean
value_kinds.description: true or false. Also accepts 0, 1, null, and the quoted forms "true", "false", "0" and "1".

value_kinds.name: Null
value_kinds.description: The tokens none or null, or an empty list (), for an unset value; any for a set one.

value_kinds.name: Enum
value_kinds.description: One of a fixed set of tokens, listed in values.

value_kinds.name: StringEnum
value_kinds.description: One of a fixed set of tokens that may contain spaces, listed in values.

value_kinds.name: Reference
value_kinds.description: A prefixed reference to another object, for example @username. See reference_types.

value_kinds.name: List
value_kinds.description: A parenthesised list of values, for example (a, b). `operators` says which comparisons the list accepts, and `items` the value types allowed inside it.

value_kinds.name: Granularity
value_kinds.description: A date-bucket size: one of the calendar tokens listed in values, or a fixed number of days between min_days and max_days spelled with a d suffix, for example 30d.

value_kinds.name: Timestamp
value_kinds.description: A quoted ISO 8601 date or date-time, for example "2026-07-16" or "2026-07-16T00:00:00Z". An offset is converted to UTC.

functions.name: startOfDay
functions.description: Start of day for an offset in days from today (negative = past, positive = future).

functions.name: currentUser
functions.description: Reference to the user running the query. Requires a username in the compile context.

functions.name: labels
functions.description: Displays only the labels matching the given patterns. Usable in fields, not in a filter.

display_types.name: table
display_types.description: One row per item, one column per display field.

display_types.name: columnChart
display_types.description: Vertical bars, one per dimension value.

display_types.name: barChart
display_types.description: Horizontal bars, one per dimension value.

display_types.name: lineChart
display_types.description: A line over an ordered dimension, typically a date.

display_types.name: areaChart
display_types.description: A filled line over an ordered dimension, typically a date.

display_types.name: barList
display_types.description: Horizontal bars, one per dimension value in descending order, or one per metric in query order when there is no dimension. By default each bar is sized and labeled as a share of the total. With two dimensions, each bar splits into stacked segments, one per value of the second dimension.

display_types.name: heatMap
display_types.description: A grid of shaded cells, one per pair of dimension values. The first dimension runs along the columns, the second down the rows.

display_types.name: divergingBarChart
display_types.description: Two metrics mirrored around a shared category column, each scaled to its own largest bar.
